description: Harvest v7: prompt libraries by country (USA, France, Germany, India; the UK has no public prompt repo yet) across entertainment, education and non-SaaS business domains, found 2026-10-28 (GitHub and web search, every candidate cloned and counted, every repo checked against the v1-v6 graphs). Ids start at P01. Run with `node server/harvest/cli.js --v7`. Each record carries its country as a tag (USA, France, Germany, India) so the dashboard can filter by country.

nodes.name: prompts.chat (USA): the open prompt library
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: prompts.csv has 2,710 rows (2,337 text, 352 structured, 21 image), each with a title (act), contributor and developer flag. CC0. Characters, writing, business, education and entertainment roles. Not in any earlier graph.

nodes.name: USA education prompts (Microsoft prompts-for-edu, System-Prompt-Library)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: microsoft/prompts-for-edu prompt files for students, educators, administration and staff (MIT); ncwilson78 System-Prompt-Library 41 system prompts for teaching, learning and administrative activities.

nodes.name: USA small-business prompts (non-SaaS: sales, marketing, operations)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: pro-how-ai 6 category folders, codewithbernard 3 READMEs (12 sections each), Steffd415 README (8 sections). No licence file on the first two: preview plus link.

nodes.name: Germany: German business and writing prompts
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: Alish123456 prompt pack 20 prompts for KMU (small and medium businesses), kontor7 payment-reminder prompts (3), echtlabs German translation of Awesome-Prompts (3 step files). German.

nodes.name: France: skills et prompts en français
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted SKILL.md: NicolasW83 7 (apprentissage-express, brief-artisan, site-haut-de-gamme, audit-seo ...), fredericdol83-dot 3 (nouvelle-idee, studio-ebook-kdp, redaction-administrative-dsfr). French.

nodes.name: India: legal, MBA and study prompts
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: indian-legal-ai-toolkit README (8 sections with prompts), claude-mba-india README (2). Few prompts: Indian public prompt repos are small. English.

nodes.name: awesome-claude-prompts (English, general)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: README has 155 sections with fenced prompts (roles, writing, storytelling, games, education); no licence file: preview plus link. No country (curated by a Chinese team, written in English); tagged Entertainment as many are characters, stories and games.
